newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks ease on settlement day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks ease on settlement day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks eased on Wednesday's settlement day amid short-term position squaring, dealers said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index slipped 3.31 points, or 0.22 percent, to 1,529.56 in the first one hour of trade. Losers led gainers 119 to 40.

Bearish sentiment on the settlement day triggered selling, pressuring the index, one dealer at Fortune Securities said. "There is a possibility of a slight recovery before the close," the dealer said. PTCL fell 0.90 rupee to 25.70 and ICI Pakistan 0.30 to 22.50. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
